name: Matxani Gran
description: An agrotourism stay in a Menorcan farmhouse on the edge of Sant Climent, on the road to Binidalí. It keeps its own organic kitchen garden — that is where the vegetables come from — and farm animals, and the shared spaces are the kind that keep you in: a pool, gardens and open country all around.
